scripts.desktop:dev: pnpm brand:generate && cargo build --locked -p visual-board-mcp && pnpm --filter visual-board-desktop exec tauri dev
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm brand:generate && pnpm --filter visual-board-desktop exec tauri build --no-bundle -- --locked && cargo build --release --locked -p visual-board-mcp
scripts.desktop:check: pnpm brand:generate && pnpm --filter visual-board-desktop typecheck && cargo check --workspace --locked
scripts.test:unit: pnpm brand:check && pnpm brand:generate && pnpm --filter visual-board-desktop typecheck && node --test apps/desktop/tests/*.test.mjs && cargo test --workspace --locked
